evidence.title: ClawProBench: Trace-Aware Evaluation of AI Agents with Runtime Coverage and Frozen Workplace-Style Holdouts

summary: ClawProBench is a novel evaluation framework for AI agents that emphasizes runtime coverage and frozen workplace-style holdouts to assess performance more accurately. The tool aims to improve the reliability of AI agent testing in real-world scenarios.
title: New ClawProBench Framework Introduces Trace-Aware Evaluation for AI Agents
